name: review-animations
title_zh: 默认先挑刺，动画代码要自己挣到通过
tagline_zh: 写完动效总觉得哪里不对却说不上来？它按 Emil Kowalski 的工程审美逐条挑：缓动曲线、时长、打断处理。
tagline_en: Your motion code feels off but you can't say why. It audits easing, duration, interruption, and perf against Emil.
desc_en: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.
why_zh: 它不夸你，只挑刺。通过不是默认状态，是逐条论证后挣来的，所以每次放行都值钱。
why_en: It doesn't praise, it flags. Approval isn't the default — it's argued for line by line, so a pass actually means something.
limit_zh: 只审动画与动效代码，静态布局、业务逻辑、后端一律不看；给的是评审意见不是补丁，改还得你自己动手。
limit_en: Only reviews animation/motion code — no layout, logic, or backend. Returns critique, not patches. Without runnable context it guesses intent from.
title_en: Animation code review that flags by default
